techs.name: Prehistory
techs.quote: Your origins are not understood, yet your people have come far in this mysterious world of Pokémon.   Now begins your journey, from this early cradle of civilizations, onto the stars.

techs.name: Agriculture
techs.quote: Many civilizations began with the plow.  The agricultural revolution allowed for the sustainability of large populations, allowing hunter-gatherer tribes to maintain a source of food without needing to explore.

techs.name: Irrigation
techs.quote: Humans can survive months without food, but only days without water.  Allows extracting Water from Wells, a key resource for terraforming, as well as building orchards for luxury fruits.

techs.name: Pokémon Pisciculture
techs.quote: Ever since man first gazed upon the seas, they wondered what lies in the blue yonder.  Some early civilizations met the mysterious Mermaids, who taught them how to fish, and how to tame and ride the Pokémon Goldeen.

techs.name: Pokémon Trapping
techs.quote: In order to survive, we will need to deal with Pokémon- mysterious creatures that inhabit this world.  The most basic form of interaction, of course, is culling their ranks for meat.

techs.name: Pokémon Domestication
techs.quote: Some say Pokémon can be made into our friends.  Our people have doubts, nonetheless raising these mysterious creatures can come with many material benefits.

techs.name: Stonecutting
techs.quote: Working with rocks are necessary in order to perform most construction and crafting.  They can also be fastened into a primitive ranged weapon.

techs.name: Toolmaking
techs.quote: Tools made of wood, stone, and metal allow for the clearing of land and gathering of wood for construction.

techs.name: Mining
techs.quote: Some minerals from the earth are more valuable than others, and it is time to seek them out!  Already, prospectors are going out to hunt for precious minerals.

techs.name: Masonry
techs.quote: Early architecture attempted to cut stones and tie them with mortar and mud, creating fortified structures and masterful monuments.

techs.name: Pottery
techs.quote: Once the quest for food has been fulfilled, the quest for finer goods began.  Humans started to carve masterful works of clay to show their prowess.

techs.name: Slavery
techs.quote: After the beast has been chained, and before robotics and artificial intelligence, wealthy humans that wanted effortless solutions to complex tasks had to shackle the human body and intellect instead.

techs.name: Herbalism
techs.quote: The wilderness can provide many remedies, if one knows where to search for it.  Our expertise in plants have allowed us to recognize rare herbs and aromatics for medicinal purposes.

techs.name: Pokémon Taming
techs.quote: We noticed that certain species of Pokémon were particularly kin of humans and could be easily bred as partners.  They can help in both labor and scouting, and of course make cute pets!

techs.name: Bronze Working
techs.quote: We found that harder metals can, under sufficient heat, bend into any shape we want it to be.  We can use this knowledge to make better weapons and train our troops.

techs.name: Writing
uniques: Enables making demands of other civilizations
techs.quote: The storage of information isn't the only use for the written word.  Eventually, diplomats began to realize the pen is mightier than the sword.

techs.name: Calendar
techs.quote: Human recognition of patterns of the sun, moon, and stars allow for a sense of timekeeping, useful for growing specialty crops or trade.

techs.name: Code of Laws
techs.quote: As civilization grows, it becomes necessary to have formal rules in order to manage conflict and maintain diplomatic channels with other nations.
